turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi there, how are you feeling today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Pretty good, thanks for asking.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The forecast says minus two but feels like minus nine. What's the difference?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's wind chill. The wind pulls heat away from your skin faster, so it feels much colder than the thermometer says.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Sunday evenings make me so anxious about work.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Lots of people feel that. You could spend Sunday evening batch cooking so Monday feels easier, or plan something fun like an early film to break the dread. Which sounds more helpful?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Just a sec, I need to sort something out with my roommate. I'll say when I'm back.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: No problem.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let's continue this argument after dinner.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Deal, but I'm still right.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Grace, can you help me lift these compost bags out of the boot?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Sure. Why are there five of them?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: They were on offer. Three for the price of two.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: So you bought five.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I know how maths works, thank you.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Wow, this one's leaking.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, mind your shoes. Where do you reckon we stack them?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: By the shed, under the tarp. And please hoover the car later.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Done and dusted. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Alright. So, to beat the Sunday dread. Batch cook, or cinema?
